# P37.40 — Changes page and change feeds

Row 464 of 510 · R11-K13-CHG-01 · Round 11 sub-round 11D · `implement-spec spec=docs/tickets/464_P37.40__changes-page-and-feeds.md live_verification=false` · Harness: devin-desktop/swe-2-high/subagent

## Requirement ids

- **Owner:** SIG-UI-072 — the §56 line's `Owner:` names P37.40 directly (public `/changes/` + change feeds; J5 "what changed since the last release?").
- **Also (cited):** the TX-14 release-diff family it reads (SIG-TRANSP-024 — owner P36.67), SIG-WATCH-005/006 (the feed machinery conventions it follows — owner P37.34).

## What landed

- `/changes/` (T1, zero-JS) — diffs the latest release against the previous activated release over the release's own manifest-pinned `sig.release-changes/1` + `sig.release-source-changes/1` + `sig.release-changes-feed/1` documents (TX-14, P36.67 — never a second diff engine). The two classes stay visibly apart: **"SIG's records changed"** (belief time — record added/removed/changed + source `added`/`lane_changed`) vs **"the source reports a change in the world"** (world time — source `retired`/`newly_failing` + `source_withdrawn` removals). Dated by release activation and world dates, never version-control dates. Baseline (first release, `previous: null`), no-release-bound and absent-diff states render as typed absences, never fabricated zeroes.
- Atom (RFC 4287) feeds — `changes/feeds/all.atom`, `changes/feeds/place/<slug-path>.atom` (descendant-covering: `usa/ok` sees `usa/ok/<place>` events) and `changes/feeds/source/<id>.atom` for every emitted place/source page — empty scopes still emit (D-K7-5's posture; subscribers can come early) — plus `changes/feeds.opml` and the paginated `/changes/feeds/` + `/changes/feeds/place/page/<n>/` directory. Feed `updated` is the release's belief-side stamp; entry dates are the events' world dates.
- `exports/release_changes.py` — feed events gain the additive routing fields `compartment`/`entity_type`/`entity_id`/`label`/`jurisdiction`/`source_ids` (computed in the same digest pass, never a second walk; `sig.release-changes-feed/1` shape extended additively — API consumers ignore the extras).
- `web/src/lib/changes.ts` — fail-closed doc validation + the two-class separation + feed scoping; `changes-feeds.ts` — Atom/OPML emitters; `changes-fixture.ts` — the committed demo diff (a demonstration second release, labelled as such); `data.ts:getReleaseChanges()` resolves `<releaseRoot>/r/<pub>/transparency/changes/**` through the stamp's seam (`releaseRoot()` exported from release-stamp.ts) — `null` on no bound release (fixtures) or a pre-TX-14 release; malformed docs throw.
- Registries — `page-types.ts` `/changes/**` T1 (owner P37.40, `sig.release-changes/1`); `nav.ts` adds the public "Changes" item; `ops/public_routes.toml` allow-lists `changes` (top_level + required); `ops/web/nginx.conf` serves `/changes/` with `application/atom+xml`/`text/x-opml` scoped types + `max-age=3600`.
- `web/scripts/check-feeds.mjs` — Atom wire-shape + OPML validation, the T0 byte ceiling, coverage: every emitted dossier/source `.json` twin mints a feed (slug-history 301 stubs excluded), and every feed href on the pages resolves. Wired in `npm run check`.
- Copy batch-26 (CHG-01…CHG-14, `pending` — agent-drafted, never operator-confirmed); `data-copy` bindings on the pages.
- Per-entity feeds stay deferred until page counts are measured — the plan row's own deferral, untouched.
